CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_integration_inbox (
    event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    subject varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    schema_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0),
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    correlation_id varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    causation_id varchar(128) NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    processed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (btrim(subject) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(correlation_id) <> '')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_integration_inbox_student_processed
    ON student_integration_inbox(student_id, processed_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_action_assistance (
    source_event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES student_integration_inbox(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    learning_action_id varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    context_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    context_id varchar(255) NULL,
    support_context varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    hints_used integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (hints_used BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
    max_hint_level smallint NULL CHECK (max_hint_level BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
    intervention_used boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (student_id, learning_action_id),
    CHECK (btrim(learning_action_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (context_type IN ('general', 'lesson', 'lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    CHECK (
        (context_type = 'general' AND context_id IS NULL)
        OR
        (context_type <> 'general' AND context_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(context_id) <> '')
    ),
    CHECK (support_context IN ('independent', 'guided')),
    CHECK (
        (hints_used = 0 AND max_hint_level IS NULL)
        OR
        (hints_used > 0 AND max_hint_level IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CHECK (
        support_context <> 'independent'
        OR
        (hints_used = 0 AND max_hint_level IS NULL AND intervention_used = false)
    ),
    CHECK (btrim(policy_version) <> '')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_action_assistance_student_occurred
    ON student_learning_action_assistance(student_id, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_evidence (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    source_event_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_action_assistance(source_event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    observation_index smallint NOT NULL CHECK (observation_index BETWEEN 0 AND 99),
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    learning_action_id varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(128) NULL,
    evidence_kind varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    source_service varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (source_event_id, observation_index),
    CHECK (btrim(learning_action_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (target_type IN ('concept', 'capability')),
    CHECK (btrim(target_key) <> ''),
    CHECK (target_version IS NULL OR btrim(target_version) <> ''),
    CHECK (evidence_kind IN ('independent_context', 'guided_context', 'hint_used', 'intervention')),
    CHECK (source_service = 'ms-go-teacher-agent')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_evidence_student_target
    ON student_learning_evidence(student_id, target_type, target_key, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_evidence_student_action
    ON student_learning_evidence(student_id, learning_action_id, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_evidence_event_target_kind_unique
    ON student_learning_evidence(
        source_event_id,
        target_type,
        target_key,
        COALESCE(target_version, ''),
        evidence_kind
    );
